io/input#

Buffered reading of an asynchronous byte stream, for protocol parsers.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let input = ByteInput(connection);
let status = await input.line([byte(13), byte(10)], 1024) else [];
if await input.ensure(5) {
    let tag is byte = input.peek(0);
    let size is int = input.range(1, 5).integer(Signedness.signed, ByteOrder.big);
    input.skip(5);
    let body is @byte = if await input.ensure(size) { input.take(size); } else { []; };
}

Description#

Buffered reading of an asynchronous byte stream, for protocol parsers.

ensure(count) reads from the source until count unconsumed bytes are buffered or the source ends. peek, range, take and skip work on those buffered bytes only, at offsets counted from the first unconsumed byte; asking for more than available() fails with OutOfRange. range() is a view of the buffer, valid until the next ensure() or line(), which may replace the buffer. An input belongs to one reader: concurrent calls are not serialized.

object ByteInput#

object ByteInput

A buffer over an AsyncReading for parsers: make sure bytes are there, look at them, then consume them.

ByteInput.skip#

skip(count is int) is void

ByteInput.line#

async line(terminator is @byte, limit is int) is Maybe<@byte>

The next line without its terminator, consumed together with it. Maybe.none at the end of the source; unterminated bytes before the end are the last line. A line longer than limit fails with LineTooLong.
